lockFileMaintenance.description: rangeStrategy:bump only moves versions a package.json declares, so transitive deps stay pinned at whatever they first resolved to and go stale until a vulnerability scan flags them (vite -> postcss -> nanoid did exactly this). This re-resolves the whole lockfile within the existing ranges on the default schedule, before 4am on monday. The 3-day floor here does not apply to lock file maintenance, since Renovate re-runs pnpm rather than looking versions up itself; pnpm's own minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml is what holds that line.

packageRules.description: engines.node is deliberately a wide ^24 range. rangeStrategy:bump would ratchet the floor to each new patch, which then drifts ahead of the CI image whenever the harbor mirror lags behind nodejs.org.
